premise: Every surprise makes shy Hedgehog curl into a prickly ball — Mushroom's sneeze, Woodpecker's TAP TAP — so he keeps missing the fun; then his friends say hello softly, and out he peeks.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop): what noise and bluster can't do, gentleness does; turned into two friends learning to whisper.
lesson: Gentleness makes room for shy friends.
learning: A hedgehog rolls into a prickly ball when something startles it.

en-US.title: Hedgehog Curls Up
en-US.text: [softly] {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog wanted to play. But Hedgehog was shy. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live talk} "Hello," he said, very quietly. Up popped {mushroom:enter} {hedgehog:go to mushroom} Mushroom. {mushroom:face happy} "Hello, Hedgehog!" Then her nose began to twitch. {mushroom:live sneeze} Ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! {hedgehog:face surprised} [gasps] "Oh!" {hedgehog:live curl hold} In a flash, Hedgehog rolled up into a round, prickly ball. Prickly ball! {mushroom:face sad} "Oops," said Mushroom. "Sorry." Slowly… slowly… {hedgehog:live curl resume} Hedgehog uncurled and peeked out. Then {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Woodpecker landed on the trunk of the big tree. [excited] "Good morning, everybody!" {woodpecker:live tap} {sfx:tap} TAP-TAP-TAP! {hedgehog:live curl hold} Prickly ball again! {woodpecker:face sad} "Oh dear," said Woodpecker. {mushroom:sparkle} Mushroom had an idea. [whispers] {woodpecker:go to hedgehog} "Let's say it softly." So, very gently, they whispered: {mushroom:face happy} {woodpecker:face happy} "Hello, Hedgehog." [pause] {hedgehog:live curl resume} Out came his nose. Out came his eyes. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} "Hello," he whispered back. And they played the quietest game in the whole meadow.

es-ES.title: Erizo se hace una bola
es-ES.text: [softly] {hedgehog:enter} Erizo tenía ganas de jugar. Pero Erizo era muy tímido. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live talk} —Hola —dijo, bajito, bajito. Asomó {mushroom:enter} {hedgehog:go to mushroom} Seta. {mushroom:face happy} —¡Hola, Erizo! Y entonces empezó a picarle la nariz. {mushroom:live sneeze} Aaa… aaa… {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! {hedgehog:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Ay! {hedgehog:live curl hold} En un santiamén, Erizo se hizo una bola redonda de pinchos. ¡Bola de pinchos! {mushroom:face sad} —Uy —dijo Seta—. Perdona. Despacito… despacito… {hedgehog:live curl resume} Erizo se desenroscó y asomó el hocico. Entonces {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pájaro carpintero se posó en el tronco del árbol grande. [excited] —¡Buenos días a todos! {woodpecker:live tap} {sfx:tap} ¡TOC-TOC-TOC! {hedgehog:live curl hold} ¡Bola de pinchos otra vez! {woodpecker:face sad} —Vaya —dijo Carpintero. {mushroom:sparkle} A Seta se le ocurrió una idea. [whispers] {woodpecker:go to hedgehog} —Vamos a decirlo flojito. Y los dos susurraron, muy suave: {mushroom:face happy} {woodpecker:face happy} —Hola, Erizo. [pause] {hedgehog:live curl resume} Asomó el hocico. Asomaron los ojitos. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} —Hola —susurró él. Y jugaron al juego más calladito de todo el prado.

ja-JP.title: ハリネズミくん、まんまる
ja-JP.text: [softly]{hedgehog:enter}ハリネズミくんは、あそびたいな。でも、はずかしがりや。{hedgehog:face happy}{hedgehog:live talk}「こんにちは」 と、とっても小さなこえ。ひょっこり、{mushroom:enter}{hedgehog:go to mushroom}キノコ。{mushroom:face happy}「こんにちは、ハリネズミくん！」 すると、はながむずむず。{mushroom:live sneeze}は…は…{sfx:achoo}はっくしょん！{hedgehog:face surprised}[gasps]「わっ！」 {hedgehog:live curl hold}あっというまに、まんまる。トゲトゲボール！{mushroom:face sad}「あら、ごめんね」 とキノコ。そろり…そろり…{hedgehog:live curl resume}かおを出しました。そこへ{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}キツツキくんが、大きな木のみきにとまりました。[excited]「みんな、おはよう！」 {woodpecker:live tap}{sfx:tap}コンコンコン！{hedgehog:live curl hold}また、トゲトゲボール！{woodpecker:face sad}「あれれ」 とキツツキくん。{mushroom:sparkle}キノコが、ひらめきました。[whispers]{woodpecker:go to hedgehog}「そっと、いってみよう。」 そうっと、ささやきます。{mushroom:face happy}{woodpecker:face happy}「こんにちは、ハリネズミくん。」 [pause]{hedgehog:live curl resume}はなが、ちょこん。目が、ぱちり。{hedgehog:face happy}{hedgehog:hearts}「こんにちは」 と、ささやきかえしました。それから、はらっぱでいちばんしずかなあそびをしました。

de-DE.title: Der Igel rollt sich ein
de-DE.text: [softly] {hedgehog:enter} Der Igel wollte spielen. Aber der Igel war schüchtern. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live talk} „Hallo“, sagte er, ganz leise. Da ploppte {mushroom:enter} {hedgehog:go to mushroom} der Pilz aus dem Boden. {mushroom:face happy} „Hallo, Igel!“ Dann fing seine Nase an zu kribbeln. {mushroom:live sneeze} Ha… ha… {sfx:achoo} HATSCHI! {hedgehog:face surprised} [gasps] „Oh!“ {hedgehog:live curl hold} Blitzschnell rollte sich der Igel zu einer runden Stachelkugel zusammen. Stachelkugel! {mushroom:face sad} „Hoppla“, sagte der Pilz. „Entschuldigung.“ Langsam… langsam… {hedgehog:live curl resume} rollte der Igel sich auf und lugte hervor. Da landete {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} der Specht am Stamm des großen Baumes. [excited] „Guten Morgen, alle zusammen!“ {woodpecker:live tap} {sfx:tap} TOCK-TOCK-TOCK! {hedgehog:live curl hold} Schon wieder Stachelkugel! {woodpecker:face sad} „Ach je“, sagte der Specht. {mushroom:sparkle} Der Pilz hatte eine Idee. [whispers] {woodpecker:go to hedgehog} „Sagen wir es ganz leise.“ Und so flüsterten sie, ganz sanft: {mushroom:face happy} {woodpecker:face happy} „Hallo, Igel.“ [pause] {hedgehog:live curl resume} Heraus kam seine Nase. Heraus kamen seine Augen. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} „Hallo“, flüsterte er zurück. Und sie spielten das leiseste Spiel auf der ganzen Wiese.

fr-FR.title: Hérisson se met en boule
fr-FR.text: [softly] {hedgehog:enter} Hérisson avait envie de jouer. Mais Hérisson était timide. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live talk} « Bonjour », a-t-il dit, tout bas. Hop, voilà {mushroom:enter} {hedgehog:go to mushroom} Champignon. {mushroom:face happy} « Bonjour, Hérisson ! » Puis ça l’a chatouillé dans le nez. {mushroom:live sneeze} Ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ATCHOUM ! {hedgehog:face surprised} [gasps] « Oh ! » {hedgehog:live curl hold} En un éclair, Hérisson s’est roulé en boule, toute ronde, toute piquante. Boule de piquants ! {mushroom:face sad} « Oups, a dit Champignon. Pardon. » Tout doucement… tout doucement… {hedgehog:live curl resume} Hérisson s’est déroulé et a pointé le nez. Puis {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pic-vert s’est posé sur le tronc du grand arbre. [excited] « Bonjour, tout le monde ! » {woodpecker:live tap} {sfx:tap} TOC-TOC-TOC ! {hedgehog:live curl hold} Encore une boule de piquants ! {woodpecker:face sad} « Oh là là », a dit Pic-vert. {mushroom:sparkle} Champignon a eu une idée. [whispers] {woodpecker:go to hedgehog} « Disons-le tout doucement. » Alors, très gentiment, ils ont chuchoté : {mushroom:face happy} {woodpecker:face happy} « Bonjour, Hérisson. » [pause] {hedgehog:live curl resume} Son nez est sorti. Puis ses yeux. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} « Bonjour », a-t-il chuchoté à son tour. Et ils ont joué au jeu le plus silencieux de tout le pré.

it-IT.title: Riccio si fa a palla
it-IT.text: [softly] {hedgehog:enter} Riccio voleva giocare. Ma Riccio era timido. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live talk} «Ciao», ha detto, con una vocina piccola piccola. Ed ecco spuntare {mushroom:enter} {hedgehog:go to mushroom} Fungo. {mushroom:face happy} «Ciao, Riccio!» Poi a Fungo ha cominciato a prudere il naso. {mushroom:live sneeze} Ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ETCIÙ! {hedgehog:face surprised} [gasps] «Oh!» {hedgehog:live curl hold} In un lampo, Riccio si è arrotolato in una palla tonda e pungente. Palla di spine! {mushroom:face sad} «Ops», ha detto Fungo. «Scusa.» Piano… piano… {hedgehog:live curl resume} Riccio si è srotolato e ha fatto capolino. Poi {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Picchio si è posato sul tronco del grande albero. [excited] «Buongiorno a tutti!» {woodpecker:live tap} {sfx:tap} TOC-TOC-TOC! {hedgehog:live curl hold} Di nuovo palla di spine! {woodpecker:face sad} «Ahi ahi», ha detto Picchio. {mushroom:sparkle} A Fungo è venuta un'idea. [whispers] {woodpecker:go to hedgehog} «Diciamolo piano piano.» Così, con tanta dolcezza, hanno sussurrato: {mushroom:face happy} {woodpecker:face happy} «Ciao, Riccio.» [pause] {hedgehog:live curl resume} Fuori il nasino. Fuori gli occhietti. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} «Ciao», ha sussurrato lui. E hanno fatto il gioco più silenzioso di tutto il prato.

zh-TW.title: 刺蝟縮成一顆球
zh-TW.text: [softly]{hedgehog:enter}刺蝟想找朋友玩。可是，刺蝟好害羞。{hedgehog:face happy}{hedgehog:live talk}「哈囉。」 牠說得好小聲。{mushroom:enter}{hedgehog:go to mushroom}蘑菇冒了出來。{mushroom:face happy}「哈囉，刺蝟！」 接著，她的鼻子開始癢癢的。{mushroom:live sneeze}哈……哈……{sfx:achoo}哈啾！{hedgehog:face surprised}[gasps]「喔！」 {hedgehog:live curl hold}一眨眼，刺蝟就捲成一顆圓滾滾、刺刺的球。刺刺球！{mushroom:face sad}「糟糕，」 蘑菇說，「對不起。」 慢慢的……慢慢的……{hedgehog:live curl resume}刺蝟鬆開身體，探出頭來。這時，{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}啄木鳥停在大樹的樹幹上。[excited]「大家早安！」 {woodpecker:live tap}{sfx:tap}叩叩叩！{hedgehog:live curl hold}又變成刺刺球了！{woodpecker:face sad}「哎呀。」 啄木鳥說。{mushroom:sparkle}蘑菇想到一個好主意。[whispers]{woodpecker:go to hedgehog}「我們小小聲地說吧。」 於是，蘑菇和啄木鳥輕輕地、輕輕地說：{mushroom:face happy}{woodpecker:face happy}「哈囉，刺蝟。」 [pause]{hedgehog:live curl resume}鼻子出來了。眼睛出來了。{hedgehog:face happy}{hedgehog:hearts}「哈囉。」 牠也小小聲地說。然後，大家一起玩了整片草地上最安靜的遊戲。

zh-HK.title: 刺蝟縮成刺球
zh-HK.text: [softly]{hedgehog:enter}刺蝟很想找朋友玩。可是，刺蝟很害羞。{hedgehog:face happy}{hedgehog:live talk}「哈囉。」 牠說得很小聲。{mushroom:enter}{hedgehog:go to mushroom}蘑菇冒了出來。{mushroom:face happy}「哈囉，刺蝟！」 接着，她的鼻子開始癢癢的。{mushroom:live sneeze}哈……哈……{sfx:achoo}乞嗤！{hedgehog:face surprised}[gasps]「哎！」 {hedgehog:live curl hold}一眨眼間，刺蝟就縮成一個圓碌碌、尖刺刺的球。變成刺球了！{mushroom:face sad}「哎呀，」 蘑菇說，「對唔住。」 慢慢地……慢慢地……{hedgehog:live curl resume}刺蝟鬆開身子，探出頭來。這時，{woodpecker:enter}{woodpecker:go to trunks}啄木鳥飛到大樹的樹幹上。[excited]「大家早晨！」 {woodpecker:live tap}{sfx:tap}篤篤篤！{hedgehog:live curl hold}又變成刺球了！{woodpecker:face sad}「哎呀，弊喇。」 啄木鳥說。{mushroom:sparkle}蘑菇想到一個好主意。[whispers]{woodpecker:go to hedgehog}「我哋細細聲講啦。」 於是，蘑菇和啄木鳥輕輕地、輕輕地說：{mushroom:face happy}{woodpecker:face happy}「哈囉，刺蝟。」 [pause]{hedgehog:live curl resume}鼻子出來了。眼睛也出來了。{hedgehog:face happy}{hedgehog:hearts}「哈囉。」 牠也輕輕地回答。然後，大家一起玩了整片草地上最安靜的遊戲。
